newsitem.title: USA: WMS gets favorable tax ruling for spinoff.
newsitem.headline: WMS gets favorable tax ruling for spinoff.

text.p: WMS Industries Inc said Friday that the Internal Revenue Service ruled that a proposed spinoff of its Puerto Rico hotel and casino business qualifies as tax free for federal income tax purposes except for the cash that is received in payment of fractional shares.
WMS also said its directors have set the record date of March 31 and a payment date of April 21 for the spin-off of the business which has been named WHG Resorts & Casinos Inc.
WMS holders will receive one share of WHG Resorts common stock for each four shares of WMS common stock owned as of the record date.
WHG Resorts is seeking to list the shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol WHG.

At the time of the distribution, WHG Resorts will own about a 99 percent interest in Posadas de Puerto Rico Associates Inc, the owner of the Condado Plaza Hotel & Casino; a 49.5 percent interest in Posadas de San Juan Associates, a partnership which owns the El San Juan Hotel & Casino; a 23.3 percent indirect interest in El Conquistador Partnership L.P. which owns the El Conquistador Resort & Country Club; and a 61.38 percent interest in Williams Hospitality Group Inc, a management company for the above hotels and casinos.

WMS had filed its proposed restructuring plan with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering the spinoff and expects to receive comments from the SEC by the end of the month. The distribution requires that the registration statement is declared effective.

The company has outstanding $57.5 million of 5-3/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2002. The debentures are currently convertible into shares of WMS common stock at a conversion price of $29 per share. As a result of the spinoff, the conversion price will be adjusted at the time of the record date for distribution. Based upon recent trading prices of WMS common stock, WMS said its board estimates that the adjusted conversion price may be in the range of $23 to $24.
WMS designs, makes and sells coin-operated and home video games, pinball and novelty games and video lottery terminals and gaming devices.
